BiblicalUsage: Thick darkness, gloom as of a lowering sky, is where God meets His people. Moses draws near to the thick darkness where God is, the mountain burns with darkness and cloud, Solomon says the Lord will dwell in the thick darkness, and Joel says the day of the Lord is a day of darkness and gloominess.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the thick darkness is not God's absence, it is His nearness in a form we cannot bear to look at. Moses went in where the people stood afar off, and the darkness was where God was.
